assumptions: closedDecisions defaults to APPLIED, ACCEPTED, SKIPPED, DISMISSED (departs from 'open means not APPLIED' so human triage can resume a run)
an open finding after REVISE or NEEDS ATTENTION halts by default; review.openFindings.onOpen 'retry' restores re-plan or fix
review.confirmRounds is a per-rigor-level object defaulting to 0 everywhere to keep the shipped budgets and the longest-path test intact
a confirmation review uses the same open-findings routing, never schedules a second confirmation, and uses new templates with the existing step names
reviews without any Decision line fall back to today's header-count routing with identical reason text, so loops-existing.test.mjs needs no edit
header counts larger than parsed finding blocks count the surplus as open
noisy-review bump and clean-review drop keep reading the measured counts
